305)༄༅/bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs gyi skong chog dang gnas 'dren mtshams sbyor bcas phyogs gcig tu bris pa'o/306)༄༅/gsang ba yongs rdzogs lha la pha

tei:div.tei:p: 305) ༄༅/ bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs gyi skong chog dang gnas 'dren mtshams sbyor bcas phyogs gcig tu bris pa'o/ 306) ༄༅/ gsang ba yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal lo/

de la bka' brgyad kyi skong chog gtong tshul dang gnas 'dren mtshams sbyor bcas phyogs gcig tu 'bri pa la/ thog mar mchod gtor bcas bshams bkod zin nas/ hrīḥsngon= mchod rlabs/ spos phyung*/ gsol 'debs/ skyabs yul/ skyabs sems*/ sdom bzung*/ yanalag bcu pa/ maṇ+ḍal/ dkar gtor/ bgegs gtor bcas/ las byang ma he gzhung srong la 'phyang 'brel pa'am/ ma 'brel na'ang rung ste/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor/ brda bsgo phyag dam bca'/ byin 'bebs/ mchod rlabs rjes dri med bshags rgyud las/ de nas phyogs bcu na lhags pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po rnams dang*/ rig 'dzin pho mo bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams= sogs nas/ yan lag lnga sa la rdeb cing brkyang phyag 'tshol gcig zhes pa'i bar dang*/ hūm̐/ bla ma yi dam= sogs/ rgyun bshags/ ting 'dzin rnams gsum/ brten bskyed byin rlabs dbang bskur/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol rjes su/ dri med bshags 307) rgyud las/ de nas phyogs= sogs nas phyag 'tshal yongs rdzogs brjod cing*/ lhun gyi grub par gyur ste/ zhes pa'i bar gtang*/ de nas gzhung gi hūm̐/ chos rnams rang bzhin= sogs nas/ phyag 'tshal/ phyag rgya/ glu/ phyi nang gsang gsum/ dus gsum sha khrag sman/ gsang brnan/ dngos grub/ gtor ma/ rak+ta/ dza gad/ sbyor sgrol bcas kyi phyi mchod dang*/ bstod pa/ bshags pa'i/ e ho shud+dhe āḥ zhes pa'i mtshams su/ dri med bshags rgyud las/ de nas dus 'dir dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba= sogs nas/ bshags pa thams cad kyi rgyal po brjod pa legs so/ zhes pa'i bar dang gzhung gi he ru ka'i yig rgya/ brgya'am nyer gcig tsam dang*/ hūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe maṇ+ḍal= gtso sngags/ phaṭa dzaḥ dza skang kha dbye dzapra skul/ hūm̐:gsang ba yogs rdzogs= zhes dang*/ zhi ba'i sngags tshar sum brgya re tsam dang*/ dzapra bskul che mchog stong*/ dpal brgyad so sor brgya re/ bka' sdod lnga bcu/ drag sngags so lnga brgya/

rnam rgyal bum pa dmigs te/ bum pa rang byung gi gzhal yas khang du lha rnams dwangs pa'i 308)mtsho la bza' skur shar ba bzhin skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/ bar bsam/ rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te bum pa'i lha tshogs thugs kar zhugs/ de dag gi sku las byang sems bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum chu dang gnyis med ro gcig gyur/ bum bsnyen dpal dgu so sor/ ka ya wā kā tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes btags pa brgya stong ci 'grub bzlas la/ las bum du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gsal ba'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li= brgya/ dbyangs gsal yig brgya/ rten snying*/ mchod bstod/ dngos grub bskul pa rjes/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lha 'od du zhu pa'i bum chu bdud rtsir gyur/ dge bsngo bcas bya'o/ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag srol dngos gtsang ma blam gzhan zhig gi lugs ltar/ de las rgyas par spro na/ bdag bskyed/ las byang dbang bskur sleb pa dang*/mdun bskyed ma ṭaṃ bsgral ba ni/ e maṇ+ḍal bh+rum̐/ phyi snod kyi= dur khrod 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang du dbus kyi lte bar ma chags pad+ma= sogs nas/ bskul btab/ 309) zhes pa'i bar spyan 'dren nas sngar ltar/ mdun bskyed 'don dus dzapra skang kha dbye ba mi dgos/ drag sngags so lnga'i rjes su/ pad+ma rig 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i bum bskyed sbyar/ dge bsngo tshar nas bka' srung ma ning*/ dregs pa rnams rang gzhung ltar ro/ dngos rol las byung ba gang dga' dang*/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ e ma hoḥ phyogs bcu dus bzhi= sogs nas/ skong bshags/ mar me'i smon lam bcas/ las byang tshogs byin rlabs nas/ 'dod don mchod pas thugs dam bskang: zhes pa'i mtshams su/ bskang rdzas byin rlabs/ brgyud skong*/ bskang ba gang spro gcig

las byang tshogs mchod/ yaṃ skang gnyis/ bar bshags/ sam ya hoḥ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ dri med bshags rgyud las/ de nas phyogs bcu nas lhags pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyis lus pus btsugs su bcas te= sogs nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por gyur cig ces dang*/ oṃ:dus gsum bde gshegs= sogs nas/ bstsal du gsol: zhes pa'i bar dang*/ tshogs snod= sogs dang*/ 'gugs pa/ tshogs bsgral/ zhal bstab/ drang ba/ lhag ma 310) bcas/ rnal 'byor rgyun dbang ltar/ ji ltar bltams pa= nas/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal bar/ oṃ:rdo rje'i ye shes= zhes sogs kyi gnang ba zhu/ gnas 'dren/ rten bskyed/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du ming byang nṛ las tshe 'das kyi gzugs kyi rnam pa ji lta bar gyur/ bar bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ lha thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ tshe 'das kyi rnam shes a yig gi rnam par bkug par bsam/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dkon mchog mthu dang= sogs nas/ gyis: zhes dang*/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das dpal chen po che mchog he ru ka la sogs pa dgu klong 'bar ba'i sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du song ba che ge mo'-i rnam par shes pa khams gsum rigs drug gar gnas kyang skad cig gi yud tsam la rten 'di nyid du 311)mchis par gyur cig badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza dzaḥ lan gsum dang nṛ a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ par bsam/ gsum pa bgegs sbyong ba ni/ gtor ma gsum skor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nan na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i ma ga ga na khaṃ ghṛh+na dam ba liṃ da'i swa hā/

zhes gsum dang*/ ting lo dang chang bu skor zhing*/ oṃ sum+bha ni= sogs kyis khyer la/ rang nyid skad cig gis dpal che mchog he ru ka khro gtum bzod par dka' ba'i gzi brjid bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bar gyur/ hūm̐:nga ni dbang chen= sogs/ rdul du rlog: ces brjod la yungs thun gyis brab pas gu gul dud pas bdug rol mo'i sgra dang bcas gtor ma phyi rol du dor la drag pos sbyong ba dang*/ khrus kyi khang pa= lha khrus rgyas par spro na/ sku phyi/ na bza' 'bul/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rin chen chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong byed cing*// gtong ba dri yi legs khrus mdzad/ khrus legs mdzad cing khrus bgyi'o/ mtshams su sngags dang*/ tshul khrims= tshul 312)'chal= bzod pa'i= khong khro'i= brtson grus= le lo'i= bsam gtan= gnam g.yeng= shes rab= shes 'chal= dug sbyong bum chus rten la byab cing*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ de'i don du/ chos dang= dge 'dun= la'ang sbyar/ de nas so sor byab cing*/ sa 'di dug gi pha yin te// sa 'di dug gi ma yang yin// dug rnams byung yangs las byung*// zhi yang sa yi nang du zhi/ sa'i gnas su/ chu/ me/ rlung*/ so sor sbyar ba'i mthar/ yig brgya dang*/ kaṃ ka'i sngags gsham du/ tshe las 'das pa'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum du gyur pa'i dug thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i ngang du zhi bar gyur cig sa raṃ mar ni swa hā/ mtshan byang dal du bzhag la/ bdag nyid rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal kun tu bzang po la rnam pa dmyal ba'i thub pa chos kyi rgyal por gsal bar gyur/ yi dwags kyi thub pa kha 'bar rgyal po/ byol song gi thub pa seng ge rab brtan/ mi yi thub pa shakya seng ge lha min thub pa thag bzang ris/ lha yi thub pa dbang po brgya byin/ kha bsgyur/ 313) hūm̐:

nga ni bde gshegs= sogs dang*/ kaṃ ka'i sngags brgya'am ci 'grub bzla/ bdag dang dkyil 'khor pa'i thugs ka'-i 'od zer gyis dmyal ba'i las sgrib sbyangs bar bsam la bye ma brab/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das= sogs khrus dang*/ swa hā/ zhal zas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: bcom ldan chos kyi rgyal po la: dri med dag pa'i zhal zas dang: longs spyod rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'bul: tshe 'das tsha grang sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol= oṃ nai wi d+ya= kha 'bar/ seṅge rab brtan/ shākya seṅge/ thag bzang ris/ dbang po brgya byin/ bkres skom/ blun mongs/ brel phongs/ 'thab rtsod/ 'pho ltung sdug bsngal sbyang du gsolaḥ glud gtor 'bru gsum dang*/ sam+bha ra 'i sngags bcas/ chos bshad/ phyag 'tshal/ sa bcad/ hūm̐ phaṭa: sngags lan gsum bzla/ dkon mchog bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// lha dang sngags kyi thugs rje dang*// rten 'brel zab mo'i nus mthu yis// tshe 'das dmyal ba'i gnas las thar// bla ma yi dam sku gsum myur thob shog zas bsngo sgyur byang ltar/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bsang sbyang*/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro'i/ mi yi/ lha min/ lha yi/ stong pa'i 314)ngang las lha rdzas dang ting 'dzin gyi stobs las byung ba'i 'dod don longs spyod bar do'i 'khrul snang gi 'dod sred 'jigs skrag zhi zhing zag pa med pa'i bde skyed nus pa mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod kyi gter chen por gyur/ na ma sarba= sogs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyis spel/ kye ma tshe 'das= sogs/ longs spyod shog: gsur gtang*/ thams cad nam mkha'i= sogs/ shog rgyas par rnal 'byor rgyun dbang ltar/ ji ltar bltams pa= nas/ gtang rag maṇ+ḍal yan/ bsdu na rang gzhung*/ ji ltar bltams= sogs kyis khrus/ maṇ+ḍal/ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba'i lam// yang snying kun 'dus dkyil 'khor du// bdag rgyud smin par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/

na mo/ bla ma sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas// kun nas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bla ma dkon mchog rnams gsum la// byang chub ma thob bar du ni// skyabs kyi mchog tu bzung bar bgyi// sngon nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags// 'gro don sangs rgyas 'thob bya snyam// smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed de// sems can 315) yongs su smin bya'i phyir// 'jug pa'i byang chub sems bskyed de// gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad// don dam spros bral byang chub sems// rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom/ zhes rgyud sbyang*/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bha ba at+ma konyahaṃ: stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang yab che mchog he ru ka yum gnam zhal ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i yab kyi snying gar hrīḥyig dmar po mar me ltar 'bar ba'i 'od kyis bskul bas dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi thugs ka nas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad sku dang snying po phyag rgya 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros te byung khyed rang la thim pas zag med kyi bde bas rgyud gang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra gu ru sarba sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ zhes ye shes dbab/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ brtan bzhugs bya/ slob dpon gyi snying kha'i sa bon gyis bskul pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su dbang gi lha phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad 316)sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin du sad nas bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri puṣ+pai pra tīts+tsha swa hā/ nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// 'di la mngon par bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis bkang ba thogs pas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rnam bum gyis dbang bskur la/

hūm̐/ bum pa spros bral chos sku zlum// bcud ni longs spyod yi dam lha// sprul sku'i khrus kyi ma rig 'khrud// lha dbang lus la rdzogs gyur cig oṃ badz+ra gu ru kro dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las/ rigs kyi bdag po snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ 'di ltar snang ba'i 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad snang stong sgyu 'phrul dra ba lha'i ngo bor dag pa yin no/ bla ma dpal he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thod pa bdud rtsi bcas mgrin par bzhag tshul dang thigs pa 'thor/ āḥ 317) bla ma dpal chen yab yum rnams// gnyis med sbyor ba'i byang chub sems// skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas// bde stong gsang ba'i dbang 'thob shog oṃ badz+ra gu ru kro dha wāka a bhi ṣiñtsa a we sha ya āḥ 'di ltar 'khor 'das gyi sgra skad thams cad grags stong gzhom med gsung gi 'khor lor dag pa yin no/ mar me bstan la/ hrīḥ sems nyid ka dag kun bzang klong*// snang stong zung 'jug sgyu ma'i sku// gnyis med 'dzin bral sprul pa'i sku// yang dag nges don rtogs par shog oṃ badz+ra gu ru kro dha dz+nyā na pañtsa dharma kā ya sam+bho kā ya a āḥ 'di ltar 'khor 'das kyi rtog tshogs thams cad rig stong spros bral bde ba chen po'i thugs kyi dkyil 'khor du dag pa yin no/ gtso bos= deng nas= gtang rag maṇ+ḍal phul/ de ltar dbang thob nas dmigs yul de nyid dpal he ru ka gsal bar gyur/ hūm̐: nyon gcig tshe 'das= sogs/ sa spang*/ zhes dang*/ bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyis// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin byin brlabs pa// bka' drin chen po'i 318)zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag 'jam dpal bshes gnyen pad+ma dbang*// rdo rje gzhon nu bla med he ru ka

/che mchog rig 'dzin dregs 'dul drag sngags sogs// bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dmigs med chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// longs spyod rdzogs pa'i= cir yang sprul pa'i= mngon par byang chub sku= phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed pa// lus btud pa yis rnams kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ badz+ra pra we sha ya phaṭa: ces/ gzhal yas khang sgo phye bas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams bkra lam gyis mthong bar mos/ hūm̐: nyon cig tshe 'das= sogs nas/ 'di gzung zhig: tshe 'das kyi rlung sems rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo snying gar a yig dkar po 'od 'bar ba tshangs bug nas tal gyis thon/ yum gnam zhal ma'i mkhar bab/ yab yum bde ba chen po'i sbyor bas gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa 'od du 319) zhu nas gtso bo la 'dus/ gtso bo yab yum byang chub kyi sems su zhu nas thig le dkar po dri ma med pa zhig tu gyur/ de'ang rim par yal te chos kyi dbyings skye ba med pa'i dbyings su thim par gyur/ hūm̐: sems nyid= lhun grub shog: dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo slob dpon gyi mdun du rnam rgyal bum pa'i snying khar me long dang mar me gzhag stong pa'i ngang las mar me sgrub chen bka' brgyad tshom bu dgu yi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gsal ba'i zhal du tshe 'das kyi ma dag pa'i phung khams skye mched ye shes kyi bdud rtsir sbyangs te phul bas sku gsum ye shes lnga lhun gyis grub par gyur/

dzapra dbyangs lan gsum dang*/ hūm̐: dus gsum rnam dag= sogs/ ya swa hā: bcu gsum pa sats+tsha gdab pa ni/ byang thal gyi steng du āḥdakar po 'od zer 'phro ba de las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs pas sdig sgrib thams cad sbyang bar gyur/ bkru+u zhing dri chus sbyang*/ bsgrubs pa'i bum chus 'jim pa bsgrub/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bh+rum̐ las rin po che'i phung por gyur/ rnam snang 320)gi thugs ka nas ye shes pa 'od zer gyi rnam par bkug 'jim par thim pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ dzi na dzig swa hā/ lan nyer gcig brjod/ oṃ badz+ra a yuḥṣe swa hā/ 'jim pa gcad/ oṃ badz+ra bha wa ya swa hā/ 'bi 'bi bya/ oṃ āḥr dze bi ra dze swa hā/ rnam par bkug oṃ dharma dha tu ghar+bhe swā hā/ skos phor du bcug oṃ badz+ra urga te a ko ṭa ya hūm̐/ nyis rdung*/ oṃ sarba bīd+ya swa hā/ gzungs me tog gzhug oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swa hā/ bzhugs su gsol/ de nyid rnam snang du bskyed la ye shes pa 'gug stim mchod cing bstod/ gdungs su gyur ba me tog 'thor zhing rten bzhugs bya/ bzang spyod smon lam sogs dang*/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba= sogs shis brjod bcas/ dkar gtor/ rtsa brgyud/ spyi bskul che 'bring gang mos/ chad tho/ zor bskul/ brtan ma/ las bzhi'i bro/ bdag cag mchog sgrub= tshe 'gugs/ dzapra mtha'i dngos grub bskul/ bkra shis/ rten bzhugs/ bsdu rim/ yig brgya/ dbyangs gsal/ rten snying*/ rgyun spyod/ bsngo ba/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor= smon lam rnam par dag pas 321) mtha' brgyan par bya'o// sgrub chen bka' brgyad mtshan tsam thos pas kyang*// ngan song ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal mthar byed na// 'di yi gnas 'dren thob pa'i dmigs yul de// lnga lam gyur kyang dag zhing 'gro bar nges// 'di yi bye brag bka' srol re res kyang*// zin la phan yon rgya cher 'byung srid na// yongs rdzogs sgrub chen 'di yi phrin las la// skal ldan srid tshe phan yon smos ci 'tshal// o rgyan pad+ma'i thugs dam mthar thug mthil// bka' brgyad kho na yin par yang yang gsungs// des na o rgyan pad+ma'i brgyud 'dzin rnams// bka' brgyad 'di nyid kho na sgrubs shig ang*// snga 'gyur rnying ma'i pha chos nor bu 'di// a khu ra sha rnga rdung ma byed la// sgrub chen skong chog sogs la nan tan du// snga 'gyur pa rnams brtson pa lhur len len mdzod// lag len 'di yang rang bzo ma yin te// chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan phrin las sprul// kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i dbang po lnga pa sogs// snga 'gyur rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes yin// 'dir 'bad dge ba dal 'bab rgyun// snga 'gyur gaṅga dang 'grogs te// he ru ka yi rgya mtsho'i nang*// chabs
322) gcig 'dres nas ro mnyam shog ces pa'ang bla ma pad+ma ye shes kyi bzhed skong du zin tho 'thor bu lta bu gang bab tu dpal chen 'dus pa rtsal kyis bris pa dge/ sarba maṅga lam//
